blocks.text: You can create VPN Service Edges in the Zscaler Admin Console. For a complete list of ranges and limits, see Ranges & Limitations.
To add a new VPN Service Edge:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > VPN Service Edges.
The Add VPN Service Edge drawer appears.
In the Add VPN Service Edge drawer:
Name: Enter a name for the VPN Service Edge. The name cannot contain special characters, with the exception of periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
Region: Select the region that you want to designate to the VPN Service Edge.
Default UDP Listen Port: View the default UDP port.
Client IP Pool: Define the IP pool that you want to assign to the VPN Service Edge. This IP pool is used to assign the IP address to Zscaler Client Connector. Click Add after you define the IP pool.

VPN Service Edge Software Update Schedule: Select the day and time to schedule a software update for the VPN Service Edge. If an update window is not set, the software updates on Sunday at 2:00 AM UTC.
Zscaler strongly recommends scheduling updates to avoid service interruption when the device reboots during a software update.

Configuration Mode: Select a configuration mode for the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) file. The file contains the list of BGP peers (i.e., Network Connectors) and their config parameters (e.g., remote IP, ASN, session keepalive timers). This config file feeds to the FRR daemon, and is essential for BGP peering to work.
Generated: Select for the Zscaler service to create the config file.
Override: This option is intended for emergency procedures only. Avoid selecting this option.
After you make a selection, click the download link to download the file.
Reload Configuration: Select a reload configuration process to apply changes to the configuration file:
Incremental: Updates only the specific parts of the configuration that have changes.
Full: Updates the entire configuration file.
This option is grayed out if you select Override for Configuration Mode.
